cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Same retroactive batch as the other two Rogers filings: 'Applies to 2010 County Council At Large B race' hand-written across the top, signed 5-2-12, clerk stamp MAY 04 2012. The Year-End box is checked and the year '2010' is hand-written next to the YEAR-END REPORT heading with a large hand-drawn circle around the whole block; neither amendment box is checked. Summary Page is PDF page 4 (page 3 is a Schedule A on which the contributor line reads 'None' and the page subtotal is a hand-drawn zero while 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' still shows 295.98). Every Column A cell on the Summary Page is a hand-drawn zero; the Column B cents are raised superscripts.

contributions.detail: exact - Schedule A EXISTS and is printed with NO lines filled; the filer wrote the word 'None' across the Name of Contributor cell of row 1 and a written zero in the SUBTOTAL cell. Zero rows is the correct transcription and this is a real zero.

expenditures.detail: exact - Schedule B likewise: 'None' written in the Purpose cell of row 1, a written zero in the SUBTOTAL cell, no lines filled.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p2 SUBTOTAL = a hand-written zero against an empty grid; p3 the same. Nothing to gate and zero rows is correct on both. BUT NOTE what the grand-total cells hold: p2's TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED reads 295.98 and p3's TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE reads 295.98, against page subtotals of zero. Those are CUMULATIVE figures - they equal the Summary Page's Column B (Aggregate Total) on both lines, while Column A is a written zero on all five of its lines. The grand-total cells on this filing are therefore not sums of subtotals and must not be read as this period's money.
itemized.notes: Handwritten form, Warren T. Rogers, County Council At-Large B, year-end, form's own Date of Report 5-2-12 (the filing is manifested as the 2010 cycle). PDF page order: p1 cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, p4 Summary Page - the Summary Page comes LAST here, not second. An entirely inactive period: both schedules carry the word 'None' and a zero subtotal, and the Summary Page's Column A is a hand-written zero glyph on every line (lines 1-7). Under the repo's zero-glyph ruling those glyphs are 0, so both sides are honest REAL ZEROS with zero rows - not gaps, and not 'schedule missing' (the schedule pages are present and printed). The 295.98 appearing in both grand-total cells is the aggregate-to-date figure, matching Summary Page Column B.
